slides.title: The calculator.
slides.body: Already knows the total rep count. Before the warm-up has started.

slides.title: The photographer.
slides.body: Takes a photo of the board every day. Has never once looked at it again.

slides.title: The negotiator.
slides.body: Sees burpees. Asks if they're optional today. They are not.

slides.title: The rereader.
slides.body: Reads it four times, hoping the numbers change. They don't.

slides.title: The quiet exit.
slides.body: Reads the board. Says nothing. Walks to the water fountain and thinks about life.

slides.title: The one who loves it.
slides.body: Sees thrusters and smiles. Everyone moves one spot further away.
